nodes.name: Call Gemini Image Extraction
nodes.notes: Select an HTTP Header Auth credential whose header name is x-goog-api-key. No credential is embedded in this workflow.

nodes.name: Return Image Preprocessor Result
nodes.notes: Returns one normalized result without Base64, provider request, raw provider response, endpoint, or model details.

parameters.content:
## Image Preprocessor V1
Architecture V2 Phase 4 image-to-text adapter. It validates the internal image contract, calls Gemini only to extract visible text, and returns normalized extracted text. It never performs scam classification or scoring. Image pixels and visible instructions are untrusted data.
